name: 18914 · Chalfont, PA
findings: ZIP 18914 (Chalfont) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18914 (Chalfont) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 18914 (Chalfont) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).
